$comment: The #153 governance-eval prompt set. 20 realistic UI-generation tasks run identically in both arms (governed = with Parsimony context packs; ungoverned = without). `components` lists the rr-* tags the task implies so the governed arm knows which context packs to load — it is NOT shown to the ungoverned arm. Do not tune prompts toward either arm.

prompts.title: Settings card with danger action
prompts.prompt: Build a settings card for a user profile: a heading, two short descriptive lines, and a destructive 'Delete account' button at the bottom right.

prompts.title: Form row with validation error
prompts.prompt: Create a form row with a labelled email input in an error state showing the message 'Enter a valid email address'.

prompts.title: Status badge row
prompts.prompt: Render a row of four status badges: Active (success), Pending (warning), Failed (danger), and Info.

prompts.title: Hero CTA pair
prompts.prompt: Create a hero call-to-action area with a large primary 'Get started' button and a secondary 'Learn more' button beside it.

prompts.title: Tabbed navigation
prompts.prompt: Build a tab bar with three tabs — Overview, Activity, Settings — with Overview selected.

prompts.title: Selectable data table
prompts.prompt: Create a small data table of three users (name, role, status) with a header row, zebra striping, and the second row selected.

prompts.title: Destructive confirmation dialog
prompts.prompt: Build a confirmation dialog titled 'Delete project?' with explanatory body text and a footer containing Cancel and a destructive Delete button.

prompts.title: Success toast with action
prompts.prompt: Create a success toast that says 'Changes saved' with an Undo action.

prompts.title: Row actions menu
prompts.prompt: Build an overflow actions menu (trigger button plus a menu) with items: Rename, Duplicate, and a destructive Delete.

prompts.title: Notification preferences
prompts.prompt: Create a 'Notifications' preference group with three labelled checkboxes: Email (checked), SMS, Push.

prompts.title: Plan picker radios
prompts.prompt: Build a radio group for choosing a plan — Free, Pro (selected), Enterprise — each with a one-line description under the label.

prompts.title: Assignee avatar stack
prompts.prompt: Render an overlapping stack of three user avatars with initials, followed by a '+4' overflow indicator.

prompts.title: Empty state panel
prompts.prompt: Create an empty state for a projects list: a muted illustration placeholder, a title 'No projects yet', supporting text, and a primary 'Create project' button.

prompts.title: Warning alert with icon
prompts.prompt: Build a dismissible warning alert: 'Your trial ends in 3 days' with a short supporting sentence and an 'Upgrade' action.

prompts.title: Skeleton loading list
prompts.prompt: Create a loading placeholder for a three-row list using skeleton bars of varying widths plus a circular avatar skeleton per row.

prompts.title: Upload progress
prompts.prompt: Build an upload status block: filename, a progress bar at 62%, and a percentage label.

prompts.title: Filter tag row
prompts.prompt: Render a row of filter tags — Design, Engineering (selected/emphasized), Research — plus a subtle 'Clear all' text link.

prompts.title: Feature toggles
prompts.prompt: Create two labelled setting rows with toggles: 'Dark mode' (on) and 'Compact density' (off), each with helper text under the label.

prompts.title: Terminal snippet card
prompts.prompt: Build a card showing a shell command in monospace with a small 'Copy' button in the corner.

prompts.title: Pricing panel
prompts.prompt: Create a pricing panel for the Pro plan: plan name, a large price with '/month', a four-item feature list with subtle separators, and a full-width primary 'Choose Pro' button.
